mapper.select: SELECT h.id,h.fund_id,h.shares,h.cost_amount,f.fund_code,f.name AS fund_name,f.fund_type,f.risk_level, f.latest_nav,f.latest_nav_date AS nav_date,f.purchase_status,f.redeem_status,f.company FROM holding h LEFT JOIN fund f ON f.id=h.fund_id WHERE h.user_id=#{userId} AND h.shares>0 AND h.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY h.id
SELECT snapshot_date,total_asset FROM asset_snapshot WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND snapshot_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY snapshot_date

SELECT a.asset_class,a.target_weight FROM client_portfolio c JOIN client_portfolio_allocation a ON a.portfolio_id=c.id WHERE c.customer_user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND a.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY a.asset_class
